thread:
maria: quick sync — planning a quiet-window canary for v2 tomorrow 02:00 UTC. aim is to validate header negotiation and streaming backpressure with minimal blast radius. posting the short runbook.

deploy-bot: rollout scheduled: job_id=rb-2026-03-24-01, initial canary=4%, window=02:00-03:30 UTC. will emit status events.

kevin: can we ensure the release-note blurb mentions the header change and the graceful fallback to v1 for older SDKs? customers need a clear rollback path.

jia: i'll add a short migration bullet and an SDK snippet. also include console path for pinning routes.

sam: suggested auto-rollback thresholds: error_rate > 0.9% for 5m OR 95p latency > 700ms for 5m. add a streaming frame-drop metric: >0.4% over 5m -> ops-eyes.

casey: propose a probe for long-poll/stream endpoints: `stream-health-v2`, config: interval=20s, fail_threshold=3, auth_grace=90s. if probe fails 4x consecutively -> auto-pin.

maria: agreed. ops-bot, prewarm windows and autoscale policies?

ops-bot: prewarm set to 7m for v2-canary pool, autoscale min_instances=2, hooks -> #eng-oncall. queue_length alert at >150 for 2m.

maria: pinlist for canary: internal tenants only: ["int-delta","perf-lite"]. no paid tenants in initial stages.

maria: deploy snippet:
```
deploybot start --job rb-2026-03-24-01 \\\n  --route /api/v2 \\\n  --canary 4 \\\n  --probe stream-health-v2 \\\n  --fallback-policy auto-pin-on-failure
```

deploy-bot: canary started. diverting 4% of eligible traffic to v2. snapshots will be posted under the job.

kevin: watching client header negotiation. ensure gateway normalizes case for `x-redwood-version`. otherwise SDKs may not be detected.

sam: alerting: set ops-eyes at error_rate > 0.4% for 2m, auto-pin at >0.9% for 5m. token_cost_delta alert at +25% sustained 10m.

maria: 15m update: cpu and latency nominal, 95p latency 410ms, error_rate 0.08%, token_cost_delta +5%. probe stable.

ops-bot: snapshot @8298765650 uploaded: https://console.redwood/inference/canary/rb-2026-03-24-01/snapshots/1

casey: 45m update: streaming frame drop 0.03%, cache hit stable. recommending expand to 18% internal after 1h stable.

maria: expanding to 18% internal. re-run with `--canary 18`.

deploy-bot: expansion applied: canary=18% (internal). auto-pin enabled.

jia: release notes: v2 rollout started during quiet window, internal canary -> 18%. SDKs older than 2.1.0 will default to v1. migration FAQ link added.

maria: 2h final check: all green, no auto-pins. scheduling broader ramp for next change window. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
